title: Poland extends deadline of call for Local Cybersecurity Centres again
date_note: CRN Polska gives only its publication day (24 Nov) for the announcement; the Centrum's own notice was not read.
geo_basis: national programme; capital Warsaw, as the source names no city
summary: CRN Polska reports that the Centrum Projektów Polska Cyfrowa has extended again the application deadline of its call for Local Cybersecurity Centres. Local government units must apply jointly, at least two per application, according to CRN.
plain: Poland again moved the deadline for local governments to apply for funds for shared cybersecurity centres, CRN Polska reports.
exec: CRN Polska reports the call for shared local cybersecurity centres had its deadline extended again.

evidence.quote: Lokalne Centra Cyberbezpieczeństwa za 270 mln zł – nabór ponownie przedłużony

validation.note: Only CRN Polska was read; the Centrum's own notice was not read.

review.note: stronger than the source: second time softened to again
